extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I attempted to demonstrate the issue by checking whether any retained-subset quantity is presented as a complete-domain rate. The only rate reported is 21/168; its denominator is the full planned set and the claim scope matches. The remaining weakness — unobserved outcomes among 42 removed slots entering the numerator as non-events — is a censoring limitation, is transparently disclosed, and is not the in-scope issue class of substituting the retained subset for the complete domain.
